question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is **By.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"By"** is used in **passive voice **to make someone understand **who has performed the job**.
 
• The complete sentence is, **"It is surrounded by a beautiful tropical forest." ​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• "**From**" refers to a place or time which can be seen **as starting point of something**. It refers to the **place or time of beginning**.

 
 
• **Example**: *He is from Kolkata*.
 
 
 
• "**With**" is used to signify that two or multiple things are **presented together**.
 
 
• **Example**: *He came to yesterday's party with his brother.*
 
 
 
• "**Through**" is used in the **context of place**, especially in case of something inside.
 
 
• **Example**- *I love to take walks through the forest.*
